title: XPerience
description: A modpack that aims to make vanilla Minecraft as visually and auditorily pleasing, and convenient as possible!
body:
The purpose of this modpack is to enhance the quality of your experience playing Minecraft while retaining the Vanilla roots of the game and staying 100% client sided. So there's no worry for any compatibility matters.

**ALL IMAGES IN GALLERY ARE DIRECT SCREENSHOTS FROM IN GAME WITH THIS MODPACK!!!** ![Screenshot of plains village with this modpack:](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4489ec92dc453d9d8ba4003657d5a5bfb6fd277d.png)_(No post processing was done and no shaders were used!)_
                          
**VISUAL CHANGES:** This modpack enhances the visuals of the game to look by far better without losing the Vanilla feel, or killing your PC. (Sky, Animations, GUI, 3D, Emissives, Particles, Fog, etc.)

**AUDIO CHANGES:** Various mods MOSTLY add more sounds and music to make the gameplay more immersive and realistic. Most notable mod is "Ambient Sounds" or "Sound Physics Remastered" which tells all sorts of stories when playing the game.

**QOL CHANGES:** Many mods were added with the purpose of adding more convenience to your experience. Best example of this is the Essential mod or Mouse Tweaks. (MC Chat, Durability, Combat, Multiplayer, Fog, Navigation, Info, etc.)

**PERFORMANCE CHANGES:** Mainly here so all the added visual enhancements doesn't make your game run like crap. Sodium, along with many other performance mods, ensure smoother gameplay across all scenarios. From testing the modpack, it will get you similar performance to vanilla Minecraft, just a bit faster.

**RESOURCE PACKS:** This modpack utilizes a few resource packs to bring connected textures, emissives, 3D textures, and QOL functions into the game. **Big thanks to resource pack creator DR7** for bringing "Re-Shaded" to us! This resource pack modifies Minecraft's core shaders to make the game appear like it's running shaders without destroying your performance. Here's a link to DR7's Discord to be updated on the lastest news and get access to beta versions he releases!
ReShaded Discord: https://discord.gg/KCbwJcyqXM 

**Also big thanks and credit to Vanilla Tweaks** for their versatile, configurable resource packs! I highly reccomend you check the website out if you've never heard of it.
Vanilla Tweaks Website: https://vanillatweaks.net/picker/resource-packs/

Apparently the order of resource packs that I set do not transfer over so here is the order so the game looks as I intended: Example Animations, Connected Paths, Even Better Enchants, Weskerson's 3D Items, Blue's Core Shaders, Glowing OF, Glass Pane Culling Fix, Default Connected Textures, Simple Grass Flowers, Vanilla Tweaks, Fresh Animations, Nautilus 3D, ReShaded, Fabric Mods, Default Resources


**ISSUES & SUGGESTIONS:** I want to hear YOUR ideas and suggestions for how I could further enhance the vanilla experience. As well as the issues you come across. Navigate to the "Report Issues" link to record your issues, suggestions, and ideas for me to analyze!
